stem:
A group of figures is shown.

Which of these figures do not appear to be a rhombus, trapezoid, rectangle, or square?

options.label: A
options.text: Figures V, W, X, and Z

options.label: D

difficulty_rationale: Requires identification and classification of different quadrilaterals and reasoning to determine which do not fit the given categories.
